F1.alt: A conceptual flow links recorded artifacts, unmade connections, and explicit claims.
F1.caption: Conceptual diagram, not a measured ratio. The sizes do not estimate how much remains unrecognized. The economic thesis is a research proposition, not an established universal law.

F2.alt: Four layers: stated and indexed; stated but scattered; unstated connection; unstated implication. Google works largely in layer one, deep research agents in the first two, and LIA in the third and fourth.
F2.caption: Google largely operates in the first layer. Layers measure distance from being stated, not evidence strength or validation. Schematic areas are not measured quantities.

F3.alt: Five non-exclusive latency classes with one source-ledger example each.
F3.caption: Definitions are LIA's own, verbatim. Examples illustrate a class, not an exclusive taxonomy; the finance warning is an oversight case, not proof of previously unknown fraud.

F4.alt: Overlapping sets show recoverable candidates minus the explicit record; the left-only region is L.
F4.caption: Conceptual model, not a measured inventory. The diagram does not assume that all explicit claims are recoverable. Membership depends on corpus, time, methods, and reference record; candidate status is not validation.

F5.alt: Fish oil connects through blood viscosity and platelets to Raynaud’s. Hypothesis 1986; trial 1989.
F5.caption: The antecedent literatures are not dated here. RA05–RA06 support the reconstruction; RA02 is only a bibliographic record. The trial reported benefit for primary, not secondary, Raynaud’s.

F10.alt: A dated precedent timeline links Swanson, Arrowsmith/LBD, Tshitoyan, and Co-Scientist.
F10.caption: Dates are publication years from RA citations. Arrowsmith is one LBD milestone, not the origin of the whole field. Materials ranking is retrospective; the Co-Scientist entry is a preprint, not clinical validation.

F6.alt: A domain-by-class matrix lists every RB case, its ledger lag or an unknown marker, and weak-source flags.
F6.caption: Cells show RB suffix: calendar-year lag. ? = unknown, never zero; * = partly secondary evidence. A case can occupy several cells. Intervals have different endpoints and are not comparable discovery speeds. Use the interactive companion for anchors, qualifications, and sources.

F7.alt: LIA’s eight method stages form a loop from boundary-setting through findings and rejected hypotheses.
F7.caption: Repeat with the enriched record. Publication is subject to rights, privacy, safety, and project authorization. Rejected and unresolved candidates remain part of the evidence record.

F11.alt: Six unscored rows ask about novelty, provenance, validity, falsifiability, utility, and temporal integrity.
F11.caption: The questions are LIA's own, verbatim. Record evidence and test outcomes separately. No composite score, thresholds, or case performance values are asserted.

case_map.title: Customer–supplier links and delayed incorporation of customer news
case_map.lag_explanation: The sample window and paper date do not identify when the particular connection first became available or recognized.
case_map.validation: Retrospective observational return-predictability study with factor and other controls; the authors report supplier returns predictably followed customer returns. This is not prospective validation, causal proof, or evidence of present-day net trading profits. Source text and receipt have been inspected; independent replication not established.

case_map.title: Distinguishing routine from opportunistic insider trades
case_map.lag_explanation: The sample window and paper date do not identify when the particular connection first became available or recognized.
case_map.validation: In this retrospective working-paper analysis the authors report that opportunistic insider trading predicts subsequent abnormal returns and news more than routine trading. The classification is a noisy proxy, not proof of illegal trading, and is not an independently replicated prospective test.

case_map.title: Enron board warnings in pre-collapse records
case_map.lag_explanation: Two calendar years from documented board warning to collapse; the warning was not necessarily public information.
case_map.validation: A Senate committee report documents warnings and oversight failure. This does not imply that every investor had access to board materials in 1999 or that collapse was mechanically predictable.

case_map.title: Madoff return and options-volume red flags
case_map.lag_explanation: Eight calendar years from the first reported warning to public exposure; this is an oversight interval, not a discovery interval for all observers.
case_map.validation: Congressional oversight records show substantive complaints and anomalous return claims; the 2008 exposure confirms fraud, but no single public statistic alone proved it.

case_map.title: Parking-lot imagery joined to retailer earnings
case_map.lag_explanation: Commercial availability and later publication do not establish when investors first recognized or used the signal.
case_map.validation: Published observational backtests report incremental prediction; trading costs, access costs and live deployment are separate questions.

case_map.title: Thermoelectric candidates from pre-cutoff word embeddings
case_map.lag_explanation: A corpus cutoff and a retrospective publication year are not a single candidate’s availability-to-recognition interval.
case_map.validation: Historical enrichment and computed-property checks support a retrospective ranking result; they do not establish experimental performance for every suggested compound.

case_map.title: Synthesis recipes recovered from inorganic papers
case_map.lag_explanation: The cited record does not establish both first-availability and first-recognition anchors; no discovery lag is inferred.
case_map.validation: The authors report a dataset of extracted entries and evaluate extraction quality; text extraction is not independent proof that a recipe will reproduce.

case_map.title: Phase diagrams reconstructed from materials text
case_map.lag_explanation: The cited record does not establish both first-availability and first-recognition anchors; no discovery lag is inferred.
case_map.validation: The paper reports reconstruction of known phase diagrams and prediction for compounds absent from its database; this is computational validation, not new physical measurement of all predictions.

case_map.title: MOF synthesis conditions mined into DigiMOF
case_map.lag_explanation: The cited record does not establish both first-availability and first-recognition anchors; no discovery lag is inferred.
case_map.validation: The publication reports a large mined dataset; extraction and linkage error remain material, and no blanket synthesis-success claim follows.

case_map.title: Lithography and CAD combined in stereolithography patent
case_map.lag_explanation: The cited record does not establish both first-availability and first-recognition anchors; no discovery lag is inferred.
case_map.validation: The granted patent documents the proposed apparatus and claims; patent grant is not proof of broad commercial performance or of unrecognized prior art before filing.

case_map.title: Laser sintering and computer-controlled layer fabrication
case_map.lag_explanation: The cited record does not establish both first-availability and first-recognition anchors; no discovery lag is inferred.
case_map.validation: The patent establishes a disclosed cross-field engineering design, not measured reliability of later machines or a lag from expiration to adoption.

case_map.title: Microfabrication techniques applied to drug-delivery needles
case_map.lag_explanation: The cited record does not establish both first-availability and first-recognition anchors; no discovery lag is inferred.
case_map.validation: Patent claims show the engineering proposal; clinical efficacy, manufacturing economics and patent validity require separate evidence.

case_map.title: Sildenafil moved from angina studies to erectile dysfunction
case_map.lag_explanation: The cited record does not establish both first-availability and first-recognition anchors; no discovery lag is inferred.
case_map.validation: The historical reviews give different dates for the early studies and pivot. Efficacy rests on subsequent clinical trials and approval, not on the early anecdote alone.

case_map.title: Thalidomide response in erythema nodosum leprosum
case_map.lag_explanation: Thirty-three calendar years from reported ENL response to US regulatory approval; the therapeutic connection was already recognized in 1965.
case_map.validation: A published regulatory history records 1998 FDA approval based on historical data. This is a regulatory interval, not an efficacy estimate and not a general safety endorsement.

case_map.title: Baricitinib knowledge-graph hypothesis and ACTT-2
case_map.lag_explanation: Both candidate and trial publication occurred in 2020; zero calendar-year difference masks an approximately ten-month interval.
case_map.validation: ACTT-2 reported median recovery of 7 versus 8 days for combination versus remdesivir control. The trial tests that regimen and population, not every mechanism proposed in the original hypothesis.

case_map.title: Fish-oil and Raynaud literature joined before a clinical trial
case_map.lag_explanation: Three calendar years from explicit hypothesis to the first reported trial, a validation interval; pre-1986 antecedent literature availability is not dated here.
case_map.validation: Swanson’s later report notes an independent favorable trial. The trial is a limited clinical test, not a universal recommendation for primary and secondary Raynaud’s.

case_map.title: Venice Time Machine joins dispersed archival media
case_map.lag_explanation: The cited record does not establish both first-availability and first-recognition anchors; no discovery lag is inferred.
case_map.validation: EPFL’s project chronology documents data and demonstrations; digitization alone does not validate every inferred historical network or event.

case_map.title: Vesuvius Challenge recovers text from sealed scroll scans
case_map.lag_explanation: One calendar year from challenge data release to prize announcement; the ancient inscription age is not a discovery lag.
case_map.validation: The organizers report papyrologist review of recovered columns and code audit. The result covers passages from a scroll, not the whole library.

case_map.title: Antikythera gears reconstructed with X-ray tomography
case_map.lag_explanation: 105 calendar years from recovery to the 2006 CT-based reconstruction, not to first recognition of the mechanism.
case_map.validation: The 2006 team reported gear-function reconstruction and additional deciphered inscriptions. Earlier scholars had already recognized an astronomical mechanism; this interval measures a specific new reconstruction.

case_map.title: Zenon archive reassembled across collections
case_map.lag_explanation: The cited record does not establish both first-availability and first-recognition anchors; no discovery lag is inferred.
case_map.validation: The catalog documents the dispersed archive and 1980 guide; a complete network reconstruction is not demonstrated by this source alone.

case_map.title: Heat-equation methods transferred to option pricing
case_map.lag_explanation: 151 calendar years from Fourier’s 1822 heat treatise to the 1973 option-pricing paper; this is a method-transfer chronology, not evidence the formula was knowable in 1822.
case_map.validation: The mapping is an exact mathematical reduction under the model assumptions; it does not validate frictionless-market assumptions or trading profitability.

case_map.title: Citation ranking adapted to web hyperlinks
case_map.lag_explanation: The preexisting citation-analysis corpus has no single defensible availability year; a direct Leontief lineage is not claimed.
case_map.validation: The primary paper documents the comparison and ranking algorithm. It does not establish a direct historical derivation from Leontief input-output models.

case_map.title: House-allocation cycles adapted to kidney exchange
case_map.lag_explanation: Thirty calendar years from the cited 1974 house-allocation model to the 2004 kidney-exchange formulation; not a delay in performing transplants.
case_map.validation: The paper contains theoretical analysis and simulations; later clinical programs are separate empirical validation. Pairwise medical feasibility constraints prevent a literal house-market transfer.

case_map.title: Fourier separation generalized beyond heat
case_map.lag_explanation: Six calendar years from Fourier’s 1822 treatise to Ostrogradsky’s 1828 presentation; publication lag would instead end in 1831.
case_map.validation: A scholarly history identifies a 1828 presentation and 1831 publication; the six-year interval uses presentation, and does not establish exclusivity of the insight.

case_map.title: Google Flu Trends search signal failed out of sample
case_map.lag_explanation: Six calendar years from original model publication to the 2014 critique; errors emerged within that interval, so this is not a precise failure-onset lag.
case_map.validation: The primary critique reported substantial overestimation and showed how a high-dimensional query proxy can fail as public behavior changes.

case_map.title: Constraint-distillation cross-field ratio law closed at stage zero
case_map.lag_explanation: The cited record does not establish both first-availability and first-recognition anchors; no discovery lag is inferred.
case_map.validation: Internal verdict killed novelty and specification; no corpus intervention or mutual-information estimate was run. This preserves a rejected candidate, not a production-model premise.

case_map.title: Historical-survival weighting analogy closed at stage zero
case_map.lag_explanation: The cited record does not establish both first-availability and first-recognition anchors; no discovery lag is inferred.
case_map.validation: Internal verdict killed novelty and specification and deferred corpus work. No historic inclusion probabilities or empirical feature distribution were recovered.

case_map.title: Sleeping-beauty coefficient measures delayed recognition
case_map.lag_explanation: The cited record does not establish both first-availability and first-recognition anchors; no discovery lag is inferred.
case_map.validation: The study reports a continuum of delayed citation recognition; citations are an attention proxy, not proof of when usefulness or truth became known.

case_map.title: Patent citations can awaken dormant scientific papers
case_map.lag_explanation: The cited record does not establish both first-availability and first-recognition anchors; no discovery lag is inferred.
case_map.validation: The paper measures aggregate lags and examples; a patent citation is use or attention evidence, not proof of commercial value.

case_map.title: Unusual cross-context combinations and later impact
case_map.lag_explanation: The cited record does not establish both first-availability and first-recognition anchors; no discovery lag is inferred.
case_map.validation: The reported association with top-decile impact is observational and does not prove that novelty caused citation success or that every surprising bridge is useful.

case_map.title: Cost shifts between connecting and synthesizing inventions
case_map.lag_explanation: The cited record does not establish both first-availability and first-recognition anchors; no discovery lag is inferred.
case_map.validation: The article gives a mechanism for varying search and synthesis costs, not a universal estimate of years saved by LIA.

layers.name: Stated and indexed
layers.definition: A claim that one artifact states outright, so a single lookup can return it.

layers.name: Stated but scattered
layers.definition: A claim that no single artifact states, but whose parts are all written down across several artifacts, vocabularies or formats, so answering a question means collecting and assembling them.

layers.name: Unstated connection
layers.definition: A relationship between artifacts, or encoded in a model trained on them, that no record states. Each side is on the record, the link between them is not, and the finding is the link itself: that A bears on B.

layers.name: Unstated implication
layers.definition: A claim, hypothesis, opportunity or question that goes beyond the link, which no artifact contains and which follows only once such connections are made. This includes questions nobody has asked.
